magicLink.subject: Sign in to Grundtone Studio
magicLink.body: Click the link below to sign in:
magicLink.ignore: If you didn't request this, ignore this email.

projectMembers.title: Members
projectMembers.directEmpty: No direct members yet. Invite someone to scope their access to just this project.
projectMembers.inheritedHelp: These people have access via the organization. Manage them on the org Members page.
projectMembers.confirmRemove: Remove this person from the project? Their org role is unaffected.

projectInvitation.title: You're invited
projectInvitation.body: {email} was invited to the project "{project}" in {org} as {role}.
projectInvitation.expired: This invitation has expired — ask the sender to issue a new one.

org.title: Create your organization
org.subtitle: An organization holds your projects, members, and themes.
org.nameHelp: The name your team will see.
org.slugHelp: Used in URLs. Lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.

project.title: Create your first project
project.subtitle: Each organization can have many projects. {org} can always add more later.
project.noOrg: We lost your organization — go back and try again.

tokens.title: Pick your primary color
tokens.subtitle: It drives the look of buttons, links, and highlights. You can fine-tune everything on the next page.
tokens.noProject: We lost your project — go back and try again.

install.title: Almost there
install.subtitle: We're publishing your tokens and minting your first API key.
install.successBody: Your tokens are live on the CDN and your API key is ready. Drop one of the snippets below into your customer app.

changelog.title: What's new
changelog.intro: Follow what's changing in Grundtone Studio and the SDK. The studio app ships continuously; the SDK is semver-versioned.

install.title: Install in your app
install.intro: Three ways to pull your tokens into customer-facing code. Pick the one that fits your stack.
install.noKeyBody: The snippets show placeholder values. Create a key above to get real integration code.

versions.title: Versions
versions.confirmActivate: Switch the active version to this one? Customers using the CDN will switch within ~1 minute.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.allowedOriginsHelp: One per line, e.g. 'acme.com' or '*.acme.com'. Empty = any origin allowed.
apiKeys.shownOnce: Copy the key now — it will only be shown this once
apiKeys.shownOnceBody: We only store a hash of the key. Lose it and you must generate a new one.
apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Are you sure you want to revoke this key? It cannot be used again.

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.body: {email} has been invited to join {org} on Grundtone Studio.
invitation.signInRequired: Sign in or create an account to accept the invitation.
